detail.longDescription: California subpoenas Nvidia over China chips and what investors were told California Attorney General Rob Bonta served Nvidia an investigative subpoena on Nov. 19, 2026, opening a securities inquiry into whether advanced chips or confidential information reached China and whether investors were told the truth. # Nvidia # California # China # semiconductors # ArtificialIntelligence https:// astig.ph/california-subpoena-n vidia-china-chips-investors-2026/
